ufs_verification_order.observed: Initial 14.5 replacement refused before rename; only predecessor ctime changed during staging sync, while identity/mode/owner/size/mtime/birth/flags/generation remained equal. Extra post-rename inode sync and directory-first sync did not prevent the refusal.
ufs_verification_order.interpretation: FreeBSD soft-update deferred rename/unlink bookkeeping marks IN_CHANGE and may update ctime; inferred cause consistent with the observed fields, not a complete kernel trace.
ufs_verification_order.change: Preserve original predecessor inode and exact bytes across staging; bind authoritative full metadata after staging sync/close, revalidate predecessor and complete census, retain strict ctime comparisons until rename. No automatic retry, ctime exception or global filesystem sync.
ufs_verification_order.regression: Native ctime-only mutation after the final snapshot is refused with old inode/bytes/mtime preserved; staged inode substitution and independently valid same-revision policy-byte changes are refused and preserved.

limits: Lifecycle metadata publication only; no runtime/helper/HTTP/CLI/startup caller or storage authority.

Existing release/root variants retain exact executed sources; no new hardware/client support.
Local TCG timings are qualification observations, not NAS runtime performance.
